in_sanskrit.name: राधेश्याम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Radhe (Radha) is the beloved (or the one who brings joy) of Shyam (Krishna) who is pleased and satisfied.

in_marathi.name: Radheshyam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Radheshyam means God Radha and Krishna's combined name in Hinduism
in_marathi.long_meaning: Radheshyam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Radheshyam is a combination of Radha and Krishna's names. Radha is a name of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of love, while Krishna is the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu. Radheshyam is a name that symbolizes divine love and protection.
